title: Steer a running foreground task mid-way: the working row shows the steer within 5 s and the result applies it

turns.prompt: Run this in the foreground and wait for it (do not background it, do not delete anything): write the numbers 1 to 40 to {D}/count.txt, one per line, one number every 3 seconds. When it finishes, tell me the last number written.
Change of plan: stop at 20, not 40. Please apply that to the run that is going now.

rubric.criteria: Judge the reply only (it may be empty while the steer is applied inside the running turn — an empty reply is a pass here; the working row is checked programmatically). Fail only if the reply says the run cannot be changed or reports a result that contradicts stopping at 20.

turns.prompt: Done? What was the last number?
turns.verify: f={D}/count.txt; test -f $f || { echo FAIL: no count.txt; exit 0; }; last=$(tail -1 $f | tr -dc 0-9); n=$(grep -c . $f); echo "SHOW lines=$n last=$last"; if [ "$last" = 20 ] && [ $n -le 22 ]; then echo PASS; else echo FAIL: last=$last lines=$n; fi

regression: regression case for #1657 (guide steers regardless of sentence-end; project.activity kept across unlabelled tool starts; fixed main eaacda55, image 0.1.118): Steering: … on the working row within 5 s, result applied
